# hg test

**What this page tells you:** every `hg test` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Run the acceptance tiers against every agent.

## Synopsis

```text
hg test [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Flags

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--tier` | `register|smoke|backup|behavioral|workspace-bindings` | — | Which tier to run. The `behavioral` tier is deprecated: use `hg eval`. |
| `--allow-repo-scripts` | — | — | Permit repo-provided test scripts to execute. |
| `--gitops` | `<clone>` | — | GitOps clone for tiers that assert against the emitted repo. |

## Examples

```bash
hg test --tier smoke
hg test --tier workspace-bindings --json
```
